summary.ja_easy: 2026{年|ねん}{10月|じゅうがつ}から、{大|おお}きなごみのきまりが{変|か}わりました。45リットルの{指定|してい}の{袋|ふくろ}に{入|はい}らない{物|もの}です。{受付|うけつけ}センターに、インターネットか{電話|でんわ}で{申|もう}し{込|こ}みます（{先|さき}に{申|もう}し{込|こ}みが{要|い}ります）。{番号|ばんごう}を{書|か}いた{紙|かみ}をはって、{収集|しゅうしゅう}の{日|ひ}の{朝|あさ}8{時|じ}までに{出|だ}します。{申|もう}し{込|こ}みの{期限|きげん}は、{公式|こうしき}ページで{見|み}てください（{要|よう}{確認|かくにん}）。
summary.en: From October 2026, bulky waste is anything that does not fit in the 45-litre designated bag (until September 2026 it was anything over 30 cm square). Items that fit in the bag go out as burnable, non-burnable or plastic resource waste. If the bag cannot be tied shut firmly, it counts as bulky waste. Some items, such as umbrellas and frying pans, are not bulky waste even if they do not fit (to be checked). Bulky waste must be booked in advance, online or by phone to the Bulky Waste Reception Center. It is collected once a month on a day set for each area. Attach the paper with your reception number (not your name) or a fee payment sticker, and put the item out by 8:00 a.m. on collection day. Check the application deadline on the official page (to be checked). Air conditioners, TVs, refrigerators, washing machines, dryers and home PCs are not collected by the city. Do not use collectors without a city permit.
